limitations: HLTV match pages are identity/format evidence, not a two-sided odds feed; HLTV was not re-read for all 25 cards in this window.
A single aggregated bookmaker display (EGamersWorld) is one reference, not a consensus; first-party prices are never overridden by it.
Identical numbers on both sides (1.80/1.80) are refused as a template placeholder.
A card absent from the snapshot is a coverage gap of the last collect, not proof that no market exists.
The 88-card weekly total comes from the lobby filter counts; only the 25 cards the lobby actually rendered could be compared row by row.

The CCT Europe #11 event-page odds block is displayed by an aggregator and labelled "by Thunderpick"; it is a named bookmaker line, not a first-party quote from Thunderpick and not a multi-book consensus.
